description:
Blue Sky Plan 5 is open on the Windows desktop. A real anonymized dental CBCT scan in DICOM format is available at C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DentalDICOM (100 slices).

An oral surgeon needs a pre-implant bone assessment for a patient who requires implants in the lower right posterior jaw. Three sites must be evaluated: the second premolar area, the first molar area, and the second molar area.

For each of the three sites, assess:
- Available vertical bone height from the alveolar ridge crest to the superior border of the inferior alveolar nerve canal
- Available buccolingual (cheek-to-tongue) bone width at the planned implant depth

Document each assessment site with annotations or markers. Save the complete assessment project to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\BlueSkyPlanTasks\site_assessment.bsp. Export at least 2 cross-sectional view images to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\BlueSkyPlanTasks\site_images\.

Login credentials: Docker / GymAnything123!
